# Anime character creator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/anime-character/

Create a customizable original chibi-style anime character from vector artwork. Change the hairstyle, colors, expression, outfit, accessory and background, then download PNG or editable SVG.

## How to use it

1. Choose your character’s hairstyle, expression and colors.
2. Try an outfit, accessory and background.
3. Download the finished character as PNG or editable SVG.

## Example

Design a blue-haired character with a hoodie and headphones. Choose a transparent background and download a PNG for your profile or a creative project.

## Limits and checks

This is a character builder with illustrated parts, not a photo-to-anime or AI portrait service. The exported artwork uses your chosen design, without an account or paid API.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
